E1804

Remote code needs a yes before its first run, and there is no terminal to ask.

What

Remote code needs a yes before its first run, and there is no terminal to ask.

Why

`jet run <url>` and `jet run <package>` fetch and pin code this machine has not run with these effects before. In a terminal Jet asks `Run it? [y/N]`; without one (CI, a pipe, `--json`) it stops before the program's first instruction.

Fix

Run it in a terminal and answer `y`, or acknowledge its effects on the command: `jet run -A <target>`, or `--allow=<RIGHTS>` naming each effect.
